title: Taking damage from cold ('The wind finds the one gap your cloak doesn't cover, and takes its due', hp-1) happened as a plain room-entry event on the Coldpass mountain trail with no advance warning that the area deals passive environmental damage, unlike combat which is always clearly flagged with a hostile creature listed.
